classification.difficultyReason: Requires reversing two different percentage relationships and cancelling algebraic quantities when combining purchases.

content.prompt:
The Happy Pumpkin fruit shop sells grapes at a price 10% cheaper than the Akrivo Stafili fruit shop and 10% more expensive than the Costa fruit shop.

A customer buys $\$50$ worth of grapes from the Happy Pumpkin fruit shop. He obtains $n$ kilograms of grapes for his $\$50$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What is the cost, in terms of $n$, of 1 kg of grapes from the Happy Pumpkin fruit shop?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Cost per kilogram}&=\frac{\text{total cost}}{\text{mass in kilograms}}\\\text{Cost per kilogram}&=\frac{\$50}{n}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If he buys $\frac{n}{2}$ kilograms of grapes from the Akrivo Stafili fruit shop and $\frac{n}{2}$ kilograms of grapes from the Costa fruit shop, how much does he pay? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.short:
$\$50.51$.

Divide the Happy Pumpkin unit price by $0.9$ and $1.1$ to recover the other shops’ unit prices.
answer.worked:
Happy Pumpkin's price is 90% of Akrivo Stafili's price and 110% of Costa's price. Let $A$ and $C$ be their respective prices in dollars per kilogram.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac{50}{n}\div0.9\\A&=\frac{500}{9n}\\C&=\frac{50}{n}\div1.1\\C&=\frac{500}{11n}.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total cost}&=\frac{n}{2}\times\frac{500}{9n}+\frac{n}{2}\times\frac{500}{11n}\\\text{Total cost}&=\frac{250}{9}+\frac{250}{11}\\\text{Total cost}&=\frac{5000}{99}\\\text{Total cost}&\approx\$50.51.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: If he buys $\frac{n}{4}$ kilograms of grapes from the Akrivo Stafili fruit shop and $\frac{3n}{4}$ kilograms of grapes from the Costa fruit shop, how much does he pay? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
The Akrivo Stafili and Costa unit prices are $\frac{500}{9n}$ and $\frac{500}{11n}$ dollars per kilogram, respectively.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total cost}&=\frac{n}{4}\times\frac{500}{9n}+\frac{3n}{4}\times\frac{500}{11n}\\\text{Total cost}&=\frac{125}{9}+\frac{375}{11}\\\text{Total cost}&=\frac{4750}{99}\\\text{Total cost}&\approx\$47.98.\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: If he buys $\frac{3n}{4}$ kilograms of grapes from the Akrivo Stafili fruit shop and $\frac{n}{4}$ kilograms of grapes from the Costa fruit shop, how much does he pay? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
The Akrivo Stafili and Costa unit prices are $\frac{500}{9n}$ and $\frac{500}{11n}$ dollars per kilogram, respectively.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total cost}&=\frac{3n}{4}\times\frac{500}{9n}+\frac{n}{4}\times\frac{500}{11n}\\\text{Total cost}&=\frac{375}{9}+\frac{125}{11}\\\text{Total cost}&=\frac{5250}{99}\\\text{Total cost}&\approx\$53.03.\end{align*}$$
